diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 (run 41e1096e) failed at ingest. In the upstream order_items.csv, the integer column `quantity` now comes as text like '1 units', so it can't be loaded as an integer. None of our allowed automated fixes can parse this: the only parser, strip_currency, removes just '$' and ',', and a redelivery would bring back the same format. I've escalated to upstream_app_team to restore integer quantities (or confirm the change so data_platform can add a parser) and redeliver 2026-10-01.

root_cause.explanation: Upstream changed the format of order_items.quantity from a bare integer (e.g. 1) on 2026-09-30 to text with a unit suffix (e.g. '1 units') on 2026-10-01. The ingest step casts this column to INTEGER, and that cast fails. The header and all other columns are unchanged. No dbt model change is involved, because the failure happens before transform runs.

evidence.claim: Ingest failed loading raw.order_items: '1 units' could not be converted to INT32 from source column quantity
The 2026-10-01 landing file has '<n> units' values in quantity. On 2026-09-30 the values were plain integers. Headers are identical on both days.
The ingest config is empty: no parsers or mappings are set

strip_currency is the only parser and it can't handle a unit suffix. The runbook says to escalate when no allowed action addresses the root cause, and export/schema problems are owned by upstream_app_team.

alternatives_considered: set_column_parser strip_currency on quantity: rejected because it only removes '$' and ',', so ' units' would remain
request_upstream_redelivery: rejected because the format change looks persistent and a re-export would likely have the same format
rerun_only: rejected because the same file would fail the same way
transient failure or bad model deploy: ruled out because the error is a deterministic cast failure at ingest, before any dbt model runs
partial export (840 rows vs 956): not checked; the upstream team has been asked to confirm the file is complete

params.summary: order_items.csv for 2026-10-01 delivers contract column quantity (INTEGER) as text like '1 units' / '2 units' instead of bare integers; ingest fails casting to INT32 (run 41e1096e). Header and other columns unchanged vs 2026-09-30. No allow-listed parser handles unit suffixes (only strip_currency) and redelivery would reproduce the export format. Please restore integer quantity in the export (or confirm the change so data_platform can add a parser) and redeliver 2026-10-01. Also note row count 840 vs 956 on 09-30 - please confirm it is complete.

proposal.rationale: The root cause is an upstream format change to order_items.quantity: values now carry a ' units' suffix. None of the allow-listed actions fixes this. strip_currency only removes '$' and ','. Column mapping and dedupe do not apply. Redelivery would send the same export format back. A rerun would fail the same way. The runbook says to escalate when no allow-listed action addresses the root cause, and landing-file or export problems go to upstream_app_team.
